1. Confirm both charges are posted rather than pending.

Sorry your item arrived damaged. To start a return:
1. Photograph the damage and the packaging.
2. Open a return request in your account within 30 days of delivery.
3. Attach the photos so we can approve the return without extra steps.

You can cancel yourself at any time:
1. Open Account, then Subscriptions.
2. Select your plan and choose cancel.
3. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date so the next billing cycle does not start.
